title: 6.11.3 Lab: A sound on an event
description: Star catch makes no sound yet. Load two sounds once, in setup(), then play a chime for each star you catch and a low thud for each one you miss, each in the one place where its event happens once.

steps.title: Load two sounds
steps.instructions:
The game in the editor is Star catch: the arrow keys slide the orange basket along the bottom, and a gold star falls from the top. A catch (the star `overlaps()` the basket, 5.9.5) adds 1 to `score`; a star that falls past the bottom adds 1 to `misses`. The words at the top show them as `caught` and `missed`. Either way `dropStar()` sends the star back to the top, at a random x, at once. Run it, click the canvas so the sketch hears your keys (5.1.13), and catch a few. It is silent: sound is this lab.

`loadSound(path)` starts downloading a sound file and gives you back a Sound to keep in a variable, the way you keep a sprite (6.11.1). The course has two files: `'/moshion/assets/coin.wav'` is a short chime and `'/moshion/assets/music.wav'` is a tune. Type the path exactly, quotes included: a misspelled path shows no error and never plays. Load each sound once, in `setup()`: a file has to arrive before it can play, and `draw()` would start a new download 60 times a second.

The starter already has `let chime, thud;`. In `setup()`, after the star's lines, load the chime, then load the same file again as the thud, at half speed so it comes out lower:

```js
chime = loadSound('/moshion/assets/coin.wav');
thud = loadSound('/moshion/assets/coin.wav');
thud.rate = 0.5;   // the same file, slower and lower
```
hints: Type the path letter by letter: '/moshion/assets/coin.wav'. A typo shows no error; the sound just never plays.
Load in setup() only. draw() runs 60 times a second and would start a new download every frame.

steps.title: A catch plays the chime
steps.instructions:
`chime.play();` plays the chime once, from the start. It goes in the one place where a catch happens **exactly once**. In `draw()`, the `if (star.overlaps(basket))` block runs on the frame the star touches the basket, and its `dropStar()` moves the star away at once, so the block runs once for each catch. Put `chime.play();` inside that block, where the STEP 2 line is.

Not straight in `draw()`: that runs 60 times a second, so the chime would start 60 times a second. Run it, click the canvas, and catch a star. The click on the canvas also switches sound on: a browser makes no sound until the player has clicked or pressed a key (6.11.1). If you still hear nothing, check that the browser tab and your speakers are not muted.
hints: `score += 1;` and `dropStar();` are already in that block. The chime can go anywhere inside it.

steps.title: A miss plays the thud
steps.instructions: A miss is the star falling past the bottom: the `if (star.y > 410)` block. It calls `dropStar()` too, so it also runs once for each miss. Put `thud.play();` inside it, where the STEP 3 line is. Run it and let a star fall: a low thud, slower than the chime because its rate is 0.5. Then catch one: the chime. Two events, two sounds, each played once.

requirements.title: Sounds are loaded once, in setup()
requirements.description: setup() loads a sound into a variable with loadSound and the path '/moshion/assets/coin.wav' (or music.wav), so it is ready before the game needs it. Any variable name works. Help: 6.11.1 (Reading: Sound in a sketch)
requirements.hint: Check the path letter by letter: '/moshion/assets/coin.wav'. And load it in setup(), not in draw().

requirements.title: A catch plays a sound
requirements.description: A sound's .play() runs inside the if that asks star.overlaps(basket), the block that runs once for each catch (or in a function that block calls). Help: 6.11.1 (Reading: Sound in a sketch)
requirements.hint: Put chime.play(); inside the braces of if (star.overlaps(basket)) { ... }.

requirements.title: A miss plays a sound
requirements.description: A sound's .play() runs inside the if that finds the star past the bottom (star.y > 410), the block that runs once for each miss. Help: 6.11.1 (Reading: Sound in a sketch)
requirements.hint: Put thud.play(); inside the braces of if (star.y > 410) { ... }.
